provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3443 MCCART AVE, FORT WORTH, TX, 76110

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: At the tiime of the inspection an episode of Barney was being played on a television while children were eating breakfast. 2 children present were under the age of 2 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System: At the time of follow up the operation had a separate sign in and out sheet, but the time children arrive adn depart was not documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System (26 TAC §746.801(19))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: This was evaluated and found deficient. A caregiver tapped a large plastic block on a child's head to show how heavy it was after a child threw multiple blocks in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): At the time of the inspection 2 new staff members did not have the required notarized affidavits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months: 2 staff members had worked through packets for this training topic, but the packet certificate was not completed by the director to give the credit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System: At the time of the inspection the operation did not have records of children being signed in or out that included the time they arrive or leave.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System (26 TAC §746.801(19))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: An electronic sign in system was implemented by the permit holder without proper training for the director and staff.  The director is unable to access the system to verify it is being utilized or produce records of children being signed in/out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Tables and Chairs Safe, Easy to Clean and Appropriate in Size: Four children were observed in a bucket seat table.  One of the 8 seats had safety straps.  A child seated in the seat with a strap installed was not buckled securely.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tables and Chairs Safe, Easy to Clean and Appropriate in Size (26 TAC §746.4501(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: At the time of the inspection there were multiple citations as a result of the lack of oversight from the director. Safety straps were not present for an unknown period of time in a piece of toddler equipment, sign in logs were not used, and records not maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Based on information obtained in the investigation it was found that infant children were mixed with older children in the morning for up to two hours until an additional caregiver arrived.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Change of ownership: The business entity holding the permit was acquired by new owners in August of 2025 and Childcare Regulation was not notified of the change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Change of ownership (26 TAC §745.437)

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children: It was determined that staff failed to follow transportation procedures when they did not account for all children while unloading.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgement when failing to follow transportation procedures while unloading children resulting in a child being left on a vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: It was determined that the director did not ensure that the center operated in compliance with the minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was determined that the operation failed to report a situation placing a child at risk to Licensing within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: It was determined that the permit holder did not ensure that center personnel complied with applicable reporting requirements according to the minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: It was determined that a caregiver did not know the number of children they were responsible for during transportation resulting in a child being left on the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: It was determined that a child was left unattended on a vehicle for an unspecified amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose fill was not at the required depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. A caregiver grabbed a child by the arm, causing a nursemaid elbow.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. There was an instance of a child being injured while in care and receiving medical treatment, which was not reported to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. Diaper changing stations were not sanitized after each diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. A child was placed in a restrictive device as a form of confinement due to behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Caregivers have been observed to be on their cell phones while in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Two of the reviewed children's files did not have release information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two of the reviewed children's files did not have addresses for their emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Two of the reviewed children's files did not have special care statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Children in Control: Caregivers were not able to control the chaotic situation in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was observed not washing her hands immediately following a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: Children were not staying engaged while waiting for the next activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: A food allergy emergency plan was not on file for a child with allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Six of the reviewed children's files were missing a statement of the children's special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: The listing of a child's allergy was not posted in the classroom or in the kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised: Some of the caregivers were not familiar with their responsibilities and how to carry out their duties while in the classroom. The director has not spent enough time in the classrooms training staff members on their duties.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised (26 TAC §746.1003(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Personnel Policies: Job responsibilities were not written for some of the job titles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Personnel Policies (26 TAC §746.201(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission: Three of the reviewed children's files were missing transportation service permissions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission (26 TAC §746.605(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Eight of the reviewed children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: A caregiver that was transporting children during the inspection did not have current transportation safety training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy did not have the required outdoor activity information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A child's file was missing current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Two of the reviewed children's files were missing release information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregiver did not have current CPR/FA training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver with a pending background check was present in the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
